exportedAtNote: Informational provenance only. Time does not confer priority or authority.

manifest.intendedAudience: Hackathon testers using synthetic data only
manifest.omissions: All unselected classes are intentionally omitted.
manifest.onwardExportRule: Synthetic fixture may be copied for testing; do not treat it as a real community record.
manifest.replicaUncertainty: The app cannot know or erase prior copies created outside this installation.
manifest.authorityDisclaimer: This software records declared procedures and outcomes. It does not certify identity, legitimacy, consensus, rights compliance, authority, or ratification.

admission.namedJourney: Compare, draft, deliberate, and export a first community meeting charter.
admission.actualBottleneck: Meeting decisions are preserved in scattered notes and members cannot reliably locate the current procedure or dissent.
admission.affectedPeople: Synthetic delegates, facilitators, note keepers, and people using assisted or paper participation paths.
admission.comparator: Paper binder plus shared text files on removable storage.
admission.whySoftware: A local workspace may lower version confusion while preserving file exchange and paper-equivalent records.
admission.noBuildPath: Continue using a paper binder and numbered text files. The software may be abandoned without loss of standing.
admission.stopCondition: Stop if people cannot inspect, refuse, export, restore, contest, or replace the operator with equal effect.

charter.title: Lantern Commons provisional charter
charter.preamble: We gather voluntarily to coordinate shared spaces while preserving dissent, refusal, exit, and the possibility of no software.

sections.title: Participation
sections.text: Participation is voluntary. Refusal, assistance, deferment, dissent, export, and exit shall not reduce standing or access to the operative record.

sections.title: Decision records
sections.text: The commons may record its declared procedure and outcome. The record does not certify legitimacy, consensus, or the inner consent of any person.

sections.title: Dissent and reconsideration
sections.text: Dissent may be preserved at the dissenter-chosen disclosure level. Any proposal may name an expiry or reconsideration condition.

sections.title: Exit and fork
sections.text: Any authorized participant may export the community record. No maintainer or host may become the sole usable custodian.

rights.name: Right to inspect and export the operative charter
rights.mandate: Provide a readable local copy or scoped export.
rights.offlinePath: Numbered paper copy or removable-media file
rights.responseDeadline: By the next scheduled meeting or sooner if needed for a pending decision
rights.record: Random request reference, requested export class, state, and remedy.
rights.remedy: Funded copy, alternate format, and independent review.
rights.expiry: Never while the record is operative
rights.stopCondition: not executable: notice or review unresolved

roles.name: Record steward
roles.scope: Maintain readable local copies and prepare selective exports.
roles.permitted: Read and append declared records; prepare exports requested by the community.
roles.prohibited: Certify legitimacy, erase dissent, inspect protected evidence, block export, or decide a dispute.
roles.replacementPath: Cold restore the exported bundle on another device and transfer no exclusive secret.

roles.name: Accessibility facilitator
roles.scope: Provide participant-chosen assistance and alternate formats.
roles.permitted: Explain interface text and transcribe an act exactly with participant review.
roles.prohibited: Alter, interpret, legitimate, or retain private comprehension narratives.
roles.recallPath: Participant may stop or replace assistance immediately.
roles.replacementPath: Use paper forms or another chosen facilitator.

procedureCards.name: Declared meeting procedure
procedureCards.purpose: Record a community-provided meeting process without executing or recommending it.
procedureCards.affectedExcluded: Community must identify affected people and absent voices
procedureCards.ruleThresholdTiming: Entered as text; not computed by the app
procedureCards.dissentAppeal: Dissent preserved; reconsideration path entered per proposal
procedureCards.expiryTermination: Procedure version may expire or be superseded
procedureCards.privacy: No private ballot or stable participant telemetry
procedureCards.conflict: Conflicting versions remain contested for human review
procedureCards.burdens: Facilitation, accessibility, translation, recordkeeping, care, and reconciliation must name funders
procedureCards.unsuitable: Automatic binding voting, rights denial, resource allocation, or legitimacy certification

dataMap.purpose: Inspect and compare the operative charter
dataMap.fields: section title, section text, version, provenance class, conflict state
dataMap.retention: Until superseded plus community-declared archive period
dataMap.correction: Append corrected version; preserve contested predecessor
dataMap.linkageRisk: Low unless text contains identifying details
dataMap.stopRule: Withhold fields that can single out a protected person

threats.title: Shared-device coercion or shoulder surfing
threats.adversary: Person with physical or relational power over a participant
threats.harm: Exposure of dissent, refusal, or association
threats.protection: No accounts; participant-chosen disclosure; session-local accessibility; paper/offline path
threats.testMethod: Synthetic role-play on a shared device
threats.residual: Device-level access and browser history may still expose activity
threats.monitoredFailure: A participant cannot refuse or preserve dissent privately
threats.support: Offer a private assisted path and paper receipt
threats.recovery: Stop digital mediation and use alternate path

threats.title: Single operator or device becomes authoritative
threats.adversary: Loss, capture, or refusal by the only operator
threats.harm: Records, export, or contest become unavailable
threats.protection: Selective bundle export, manual copies, restore drill, replaceable role card
threats.testMethod: Cold restore on a second browser profile/device
threats.residual: People may fail to maintain current copies
threats.monitoredFailure: Restore requires the original operator or undocumented secret
threats.support: Fund a second device and operator drill
threats.recovery: Restore from latest scoped export; retain conflicting versions

comparator.note: Paper binder and numbered files documented.
